summary: Mentari Therapeutics, Inc. (formerly InMed Pharmaceuticals Inc.), a British Columbia company listed on Nasdaq under INM, filed an 8-K covering a legal name change effective November 4, 2026 and a board-approved 1-for-10 share consolidation adopted October 23, 2026 without a separate shareholder vote, together with AGM voting results and other items. The name and consolidation precede a previously disclosed May 19, 2026 merger and reorganization agreement, as amended July 6, 2026, involving a Nevada redomestication and two-step merger with Mentari. No deal terms were stated in this excerpt; the merger closing timeline remains the key watch item.
